independent_arithmetic_examples.C_ceiling_boundary: If original Ccorrect equals Ctotal, the required+1 C gain cannot pass; frozen gate rejects with no relaxation.

pipeline_preconditions: Root supplies the canonical sealed TRAIN report named by MODEL_SEAL; evaluate binds its embedded artifact/raw/execution/plan/freeze refs, while runtime MODEL admission checks the sealed report bytes and positive verdict.
Only actual closed TRAIN/DEV artifacts from current immutable source/model admissions are scored; source review cannot establish runtime gradient/timing/CPU/network success.
Final bind consumes the frozen evaluator replay and does not repeat the gold join.
scope_limits: Actual parameter tensors, gradients, learned artifacts, model outputs and source annotation values were not read.

The producer FP32 effective-delta hash is not independently recomputed with an assumed FMA/float32 rounding order; mathematical BA nonzero is independently checked from factor bytes by the frozen scorer.
Missing class or C-ceiling impossibility yields failed frozen diagnostic gates; no data redraw, calibration, CONF, threshold tuning or promotion is authorized.
Runtime enforcement/publication guards were separately reviewed by their owners; this focused report grants no execution or scoring admission.

source_checks.assessment: Independently specified four r4 A/B pairs and four existing head tensors; canonical base64, exact float32le byte/hash identity and finiteness are checked.

Row-major B[1024,4] times A[4,1024] indexing is correct. This proves mathematical nonzero BA from decoded factors. Producer FP32/FMA delta hashes and norms are explicitly not claimed as independent bit-exact float64 replay.
All511 unique stock backbone names/shapes are independently generated; complete before/after hash aggregates, original head identity and exact initial-zero B are required.
Each intended tensor must change; every module has at least one finite nonzero B-gradient step matching raw receipts and maximum norm. Last-step trainable manifest is bound to exported tensor hashes.
TRAIN auditor uses existing closed raw/inputs/artifact, not original annotation choices; checks fixed ordered24 forward/backward/optimizer steps and corrected2 bank reads.
T1 all-head stable softmax maps C,N,E to E,C,N; native first-maximum tie order and exact-half binary No are preserved, without renormalizing E against C.
Brier is the sum of three squared probability errors per case, averaged across24; NLL uses fixed1e-12 floor with clipping count and unclipped-finiteness disclosure.

Frozen+2 total improvement,+1 contradiction improvement, each-class presence/correctness and nonincrease in both proper scores apply against original/native and both retrieval comparators. No C-ceiling relaxation or redraw branch exists.

Closed actual DEV phase, source/runtime integrity and all96 complete reader outputs are required before original annotated-source read. Failed/partial phases retain rejection without gold-derived metrics.
Fresh original-head/no-LoRA state and sealed adapted-state manifests are checked; original/adapted native token/text identities match exactly.
Exclusive reservation and per-choice fsynced attempt log precede each of exactly24 fixed DEV choice traversals; source authenticity is verified first and the other roles/evidence fields are unused.

Final publication binding compares current actual execution, exact evidence references and canonical results with frozen replay; publication checks_passed is separated from evaluated integrity/diagnostic verdicts and no promotion/rank claim is admitted.
